## ⭐ The direction is FORCED, ⛔ not adjudicated — and the landed sibling is the shape

objectui#9853 → PR objectui#9896 (merged) settled this class by measurement, ⛔ not by choosing: `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:867` declares `pageSize: z.number().int().positive().default(25)` and `view.test.ts:1458`/`:1466` **pin the zero/negative refusals by name**. And objectui#9808's standing position: 「让两张脸对越界值响亮地拒绝或钳制 … **声明面的上界要据实上报维护者**,⛔ 不要跨仓伸手」.

⇒ the shape to copy is what landed on `ObjectGrid`: **one resolver at every read point**, fail-soft to the site's own default, **one conditional** diagnostic naming the member and the value. ⛔ Not a silent clamp.

## ⚠️ The ablation trap this card's sibling measured the hard way

objectui#9853's **flat-site** ablation came back **GREEN 13/13** — because for the value `0` the discarded spelling produced the **same** answer the new resolver produces. ⇒ ⛔ **no assertion written about `0` can redden that kind of site.** The pin had to be rebuilt on **truthy-invalid** values (`-10`, `25.5`), which is what the two spellings actually disagree about.

⇒ ⭐ **ablate with those, ⛔ not with `0`.**

## 在飞相交检查

This seat's other live cards are objectui#9899 (`packages/react`) and objectui#9889 (`packages/app-shell/.../widgets.tsx`); in the merge queue, PR objectui#9920 (`packages/fields`) and PR objectui#9923 (`app-shell/.../SchemaForm.tsx`). ⛔ None touches `packages/plugin-list`. ⚠️ Measure adjacency from a **PR file list or a claim's declared surface** — ⛔ never a title, ⛔ never a branch name.

## ⚠️ A standing caution this seat now owes every card it filed itself

⛔ **Two cards this seat filed today had their framing corrected by the dev that took them** — objectui#9914 (an illustration naming a field type that ⛔ cannot reach the arm at all) and objectui#9912 (a population count and an inference that were false for 12 of 14 rows). In both, the **dev report being relayed was accurate** and the clause **this seat added** was not.

⇒ ⭐ **the measured parts of this card are the dev report's; the glosses, counts and illustrations are this seat's and are ⛔ NOT measured.** Treat them as hypotheses and re-derive. If a gloss does not survive, **the reading wins** — say so.
